reason: Ensure auditd Collects Changes to Cron Jobs - /etc/cron.d/. At a minimum, the audit system should collect administrator actions for all users and root. If the auditd daemon is configured to use the augenrules program to read audit rules during daemon startup (the default), add the following lines to a file with suffix .rules in the directory /etc/audit/rules.d: -w /etc/cron.d/ -p wa -k cronjobs If the auditd daemon is configured to use the auditctl utility to read audit rules during daemon startup, add the following lines to /etc/audit/audit.rules: -w /etc/cron.d/ -p wa -k cronjobs
estimated_impact: filesystems affected; auditd misconfiguration; cron job tampering
